ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT(this“Agreement")is Corporation with an address at 592 Trinity Avenue, Bronx, New York 10455 ("Owner") and 550 Trinity LLC, a New York State Limited Liability Company, with an address at 235 Franklin Avenue, #B4, Brooklyn, New York 11205 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is owner infeeofcertainland intheBoroughof theBronx, City and State of New York known as Lot 145 and Block 2623 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,and by the street address 592 Trinity Avenue,Bronx, New York 10455 and more buildings and improvements ("Owner's Building") now or hereafter located thereon ("Owner's Premises"); and WHEREAS,Developer is owner of a leasehold estate in and to certainland in the Boroughof theBronx,City andStateofNewYorkknown asLot0142andBlock2623on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and by the street address 550 Trinity Avenue, Bronx, New York 10455 and more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part located thereon (*Developer's Premises"); and Owner's Premises and Developer's Premises are collectively referred to as the “Premises"); and WHEREAS, Developer intends to demolish, in whole or in part, the Developer's Building and to construct a new building or a renovation or alteration of the Developer's Building upon all or a portion of the Developer's Premises and other properties that may hereafter be acquired by Developer and to develop and construct a new building thereon ("New Building") and Developer shall be permitted to use a portion of the Owner's Premises to perform various construction work at the New Building and in consideration thereof, Developer shall be obligated to install a new roof on the Owner's Premises; and WHEREAS, the Owner's Building contains less Floor Area (as hereinafter defined) than is now available for use on the Owner Premises pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Premises and any Additional Parcels (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, Developer intends for the New Building to contain more Floor Area than is now available for use on Developer's Premises pursuant to the Zoning Resolution if Developer's Premises were a separate zoning lot, and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for the Combined Zoning Lot (as hereinafterdefined)soas tomake available theExcessDevelopmentRightsforutilization in connection with the construction and maintenance of the New Building, and Owner is willing to make such Excess Development Rights available to Developer in perpetuity;
